about: Acceptance checklist, one entry per verifiable feature. Flip passes to true only after running its verify step. Never delete or reword an entry to make it pass; add a new one instead.

backlog.description: Exported .drawio.svg weighs 2.5 MB because draw.io embeds PNG fallbacks for every HTML label
Release workflow publishing prebuilt binaries, as a download fallback in bin/noodle
CNP global view (all components, on-prem + AWS + GCP) as the first large test of cable management
Labels render code-like text literally: JetBrains Mono ligatures are disabled, so '<app>-frontend' keeps its hyphen
backlog.verify: go test ./cmd/noodle -run TestNoLigatures, and a node titled '<app>-frontend' renders with a plain hyphen in the PNG

backlog.description: Element and zone field status: planned | deprecated, rendered as hatch or dotted style with a legend entry (ADR-0008)
backlog.verify: a spec with a planned node and a planned zone lints and renders; the legend lists 'planned'

backlog.description: Element field multiplicity: <text>, rendered as two dashed offset copies behind the box, footprint known to the lint, text listed in the legend (ADR-0008)
backlog.verify: a stacked node next to an edge within 20 px is reported by the lint

backlog.description: Lint reports text overflow in cards, notes and the legend, not only in nodes
backlog.verify: a legend card too narrow for 'object reference, not traffic' fails the lint

backlog.description: h: auto for cards and height: auto for the canvas, sized from their content
backlog.verify: a card with h: auto has no more than one empty line of padding after rendering

backlog.description: noodle build <dir> --out <dir> --themes dark,light --png [--svg]: lints and renders every spec in one call, SVG opt-in
backlog.verify: one command rebuilds a folder of three specs in both themes

backlog.description: Symbolic edge endpoints: from: node.side@ratio, so moving a node does not break its edges
backlog.verify: moving a node 40 px keeps every attached edge valid without editing paths

backlog.description: Named lanes (lanes: {name: {x|y}}) reusable in edge paths, for backbones and corridors
backlog.verify: two edges sharing a lane stay parallel after the lane moves

backlog.description: Zone-relative node positions and zone layout: row | column with gap, zone auto-sized to its content
backlog.verify: a zone with layout: row places three nodes without absolute coordinates

backlog.description: Lint findings carry a fix hint (e.g. 'try label_offset [0,-22]', 'move endpoint to y >= 437')
backlog.verify: every overlap and badge-on-icon finding prints a hint

backlog.description: Structured gaps: gaps: [{id, title, text, on: [ids]}] generate the badges and the Gaps card; the lint rejects orphan badges and entries
backlog.verify: a badge with no gaps entry fails the lint

backlog.description: Steps card generated from edge step_text in step order, so the card and the arrows never disagree
backlog.verify: removing a numbered edge removes its line from the card

backlog.description: Context view preset: view kind context, focus <node>: callers | gateway | focus namespace | reachable | denied, derived from the model
backlog.verify: the app-runtime-view regression fixture can be produced from a model with one focus id

backlog.description: Lookup card type: two columns 'I want to change... -> go to', for repository and ownership maps
backlog.verify: a card with rows: [[q, a], ...] renders aligned columns

backlog.description: Provenance field ref on nodes and edges (file:line or command), listed in an optional sources card
backlog.verify: a node with ref: prints it in the sources card

backlog.description: Edge field via: <node> for actions through an intermediary (a controller writing through kube-apiserver): drawn direct with a 'via' marker, and it may carry a step
backlog.verify: an async edge with via: kube-apiserver and step [B] lints and shows the via marker

backlog.description: Long zone sub text wraps to a second line (or the lint caps its length) instead of blocking corridors as a title obstacle
backlog.verify: a zone with a 90-character sub leaves a lane 20 px right of its title free

backlog.description: Edge labels never overflow from a vertical segment: auto-placed on the nearest horizontal segment, or rotated
backlog.verify: an edge whose only free segment is vertical gets a label that overlaps no zone or node

backlog.description: Regression fixtures: three anonymized diagrams from a second real platform in examples/platform-regression, linted by init.sh and CI
backlog.verify: scripts/init.sh lints every spec in examples/platform-regression

backlog.description: noodle preview <spec> --tiles [--focus <id>]: overlapping tiles of about 1500 px, and a crop around one element, so an agent reviews at full resolution what the downsampled 6000 px PNG hides
backlog.verify: a 6000 px wide spec yields tiles no wider than 1600 px that cover the whole canvas, and --focus crops around the given id

backlog.description: Lint reports a denied connection without enforced_by as intent only (ADR-0010), so gaps like CNP G1 come from the tool instead of a hand-written card
backlog.verify: the CNP example yields one finding for x-cross-tenant and none once enforced_by names an existing policy element

backlog.description: Lint reports zones, nodes and cards that overlap the title, subtitle and meta header
backlog.verify: a system whose top zone starts at y 40 under a three-line meta fails the lint

backlog.description: Lint reports a card whose generated or listed lines are taller than the card, the legend included
backlog.verify: a legend card 120 px high listing six kinds fails the lint
